validation_target.rule: first recorded validation checkpoint at or below the fixed threshold; no interpolation

protocol.rad_rule: sample without replacement with probabilities proportional to (|r|-min(|r|)+1e-8)^2
protocol.qr_rule: SVD modes retained to the squared-singular-value energy threshold; pivoted QR selects distinct pool indices; Sobol fills remaining active slots
protocol.note: All methods share the per-seed warm-up weights, Adam state, supervised batches, held-out time split, candidate pool, and independent residual evaluation pool.
